Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit 71a17e3372e7bd08ae2fd63428d9fe13883aff39

https://deploy-preview-3601--instantsearchjs.netlify.com
The lint job indicates you used `Function` as a type somewhere in TS, and suggests to avoid it by a real annotation: `() => {}` (with types filled in)
@francoischalifour Thanks for your feedbacks! They're applied. I'd appreciate your feedbacks on tests.

~I need to discuss something. `VoiceSearchHelper` is instantiated in `connectVoiceSearch`. The instance stores bunch of statuses. However the connector is called only once when creating VoiceSearch widget. It means if user puts VoiceSearch widget more than one on a same page, all the widgets will have same statuses. Is this correct?~
~Having more than one VoiceSearch widget doesn't make any sense. And even if user does, the widgets cannot be used at the same time. Do we consider statuses being shared in several widgets as an issue? If so, the instantiation of the helper should be done in creation of the component. IMO, it's not an issue. What do you think? @Haroenv @francoischalifour~

Ignore this. I was confused at the moment.
